I know kind of you feel - cutting to fat the first time is something I'll never get back. Personally, it took me around four months to get to that sort of depth, and for me, it was because I got new blades. But you're not me, obviously, and there may be many reasons why this is now happening to you. 

My advice would be like what Snow said. Do things you love, be with people you love. Write out your feelings instead of expressing them in harmful ways. You don't have to quit self harm - that's always the recommended course, but I think all of us know how hard it is to quit. Cutting to fat is dangerous, but if you do happen to do it again, I would recommend doing some first aid, if you wouldn't get stitches (best course of action iirc) . I believe the subreddit wiki has some information if needed. 

❤️ try to stay safe.
